name: M4 heat-set insert (CNC Kitchen M4 x 8.1)
summary: Brass insert melted into a printed part. Needs a 5.7 mm hole at least 9.1 mm deep.
source: CNC Kitchen metric insert table: M4 x 8.1 is 8.1 mm long and 6.3 mm across the knurl, wants a 5.7 mm hole at least 9.1 mm deep and at least 2.1 mm of plastic around the hole. Other brands of the same nominal size differ by a few tenths, so test-fit one before printing a whole enclosure.
